parameter.units_comment: space delimited ISO 8601 format up to seconds

parameter.comment: Base Date for time stamping purposes. Optional, default = 1950/1/1
Computation threads for shared memory computation (default=auto)
Number of domain blocks; default equals Threads. Recommend NumBlocks >= Threads.

BathyminNetcdf.comment: bathymetry is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (computes from layer depth and openPoints. Default = 1

RugosityinNetcdf.comment: Rugosity of the seabed is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (Default = 0, read from constant input value)

D50inNetcdf.comment: D50 (median diameter) of the seabed is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (Default = 0, read from constant input value)

SshinNetcdf.comment: Sea surface height is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (Default = 0, use zero sea surface height)

rate_seconds.comment: emission step in seconds. 3600 is a tracer per hour. it should be bigger than dt_simulation

rate_trcPerEmission.comment: number of tracers emiited every rate_seconds. 5 is a 5 tracers per rate_seconds

type.comment: Passive base tracer: no buoyancy, settling, degradation or biofouling kernels.

DiffusionCoeffVert.comment: Vertical diffusion coefficient; used directly. Default = 0.000001.

DiffusionCoeffHorzBkg.comment: Horizontal background term; defaults to the final DiffusionCoeffHorz when omitted

DiffusionCoeffHorTurbVelLimiter.comment: Horizontal turbulent velocity multiplier. Default = 0.0 range [0,1].

BeachingStopProb.comment: Probablity of beaching stopping a tracer. Default = 50%

BeachingLevel.comment: Level above which beaching can occur. Default = -3.0

AddBottomCell.comment: add openpoint to bottom cell. Default = 0.0.
